name: Demeter
source:
The Goddess of the Harvest, a loving mother and a strong-willed woman. She has fought many battles, both against formidable foes and her own self.

She now lives a relatively peaceful life with her daughter, Persephone. Yet when one day she disappears, she will abandon everything to find her.
